title: Close the bounded same-slot product receipt derivation and actual charge ledger
selected_design: Keep original coefficient insertion; one later immutable conditional replacement retains actual donor d*b/c*b; recipient consumes through its existing coefficient lookup.
required_order: Re-observe heads, issue ownership and exact checkpoint034 publication; use a new isolated branch and keep shared overviews unchanged.
Specify a sealed one-pair-per-segment source recipe with two nonstationary sibling projections, exact axis-dependent operands and donor-before-recipient order.
Bind a strong evaluation nonce, bounded fixed-shape immutable receipt, exact-slot conditional replacement and inaccessible stale fields to current cache/source ownership.

Derive a native-dispatch latch at every remaining callback and both skip positions; preserve original outer method-binding order, prospective guards, mutation/cancellation/exception and nested-writer behavior.

Write a complete charged trace including source preparation, all admission/receipt/retention work, zero/identity and stationary cases. The one-operation margin must survive every actual added charge for the eligible native pair.
Only after these proofs close, implement the bounded candidate and run exact differential/hostile controls. Hold any unresolved or nonpositive result without expanding scope.

If implementation is accepted, execute unchanged complete P11 and L03 requests, then original28 and relevant complete regression/local/release evidence on the actual changed cut; preserve failed exits and all earlier attempts.
controls: stationary recipient and interleaved pair prevention
donor/recipient Fraction and record alias mutation
cancellation at added replacement and remaining original boundaries
nested replacement/eviction, failed source batch and unchanged pending cursors

excluded: new persistent numerical cache or side-table recovery
hosted or paid CI, forced ref updates, other-owner branch advancement, merge or release acceptance
hold_rule: Do not implement while an operational proof or positive complete eligible-group charge ledger is missing. Conditional algebra and a static +1 trace are not measured product savings.
